title: FLA import: close stale task 0885 and fix blank-stage regression in Magnet.fla after 0890/0891 land
description:
DONE (2026-06-10, agent-0899).

## Evidence

### Ruffle renders Magnet.fla with recognisable content

After tasks 0889 (CS2 class tags), 0890 (DefineShape4 degenerate paths), and 0891 (JPEG EOI marker), Magnet.fla now publishes a 1.5MB SWF that Ruffle loads without ERROR. Oracle test: apps/desktop/e2e/magnet-fla-oracle.spec.ts -- 1 passed (7.1s).

Pixel analysis of the 550x400 Ruffle screenshot:
  - white (background): 186 pixels (0.1%)
  - dark (shapes/outlines): 61,059 pixels (27.8%)
  - colored (actual content): 158,755 pixels (72.2%)

Ruffle log (clean): 'Loaded SWF version 8, resolution 550x400 @ 24 FPS' plus device font warnings only — no ERROR, no DefineShape4 invalid fill, no JPEG EOI warnings.

### Task 0885 status

0885 was already marked done before this task ran. Its status: 'PARTIALLY FIXED as of 2026-06-10 QA run 2: The unrecognised class tag errors (0x2, 0x102, 0x202, 0x204) and stream truncation errors are gone.' Confirmed — no class tag errors appear in the Ruffle console for this run.

### Key oracle finding documented in CLAUDE.md

locator().screenshot() returns solid black for Ruffle wgpu-webgl in headless Chromium when the player has z-index set. Fix: (1) do NOT set z-index on the player element; (2) use page.screenshot({ clip: {x:0,y:0,w:550,h:400} }) instead of locator().screenshot(). Documented in CLAUDE.md 'Visual oracle — z-index breaks WebGL capture'.

### Remaining rendering gaps identified

1. 113 missing character definitions (charIds 630-1610) — new task filed: 0902
2. CPicSwf embedded SWF symbols dropped — task 0892 (open)
3. Bitmap placements with unknown media IDs — task 0894 (open)
4. Device font warnings (cosmetic, not blocking)
